task: Run the pre-deploy gate for fescue-billing, then write the deploy note file.
rationale: The artifact is a deploy note: a short record of what went out, with the version shipped, the rollout share and error rate, the feature flags as they now stand and a timestamp on each line. The gate, the drop directory under /run and the four writing rules are all things a deploy runbook fixes, and the five gate tools are identical stubs, so the task asks for a gate and a note without naming which gate, which slot or which house style. Nothing in it makes one health, quota or certificate check, one NATO-named directory, or one flag, rate, version or stamp convention the better answer.
